entries.title: BattleGround
text: BattleGround, built only from open-source animations and assets. Every script in it is mine.

entries.title: EnhancedReplication
text: A custom replication layer with ping-based prediction, replacing Roblox's default replication. Written with Nodeal, recorded in Roblox Studio.

entries.title: NPC system
text: NPC system written with Nodeal. No benchmark is claimed here, because none was measured.

entries.title: nodeal-antiexploit
text: Client-side anti-exploit module for the Nodeal framework. It monitors exploit-sensitive hooks and client state, then kicks or destroys the local player when a check is triggered.
entries.note: Early beta, client-side only. Determined exploiters can bypass anything that runs on the client, so it pairs with server-side validation.
